title: Scottish Social Attitudes: trust and devolution
discussion_signal: The discussion reports a substantial fall in trust in the Scottish Government to work in Scotland’s best interests, reinforcing the atlas finding that voting norms can coexist with low perceived influence and weakened institutional trust.
linked_research_question: How does Scottish democratic legitimacy combine durable voting norms with low perceived influence, weakened institutional trust, and economic insecurity gradients?
limits: The post gives a headline trend without the full survey context
Trust is a perception and not a direct measure of government performance
The result is Scotland-specific and does not establish causes of the decline
